description: Confirms that the t2v task finalizes motion prompts, discovers model/duration/ratio from the live payload, saves a draft with mandatory --duration, and hands off paid execution and download.
expectations: Prompts without motion intent are handed off to dreamina-prompt-text2video
--duration is mandatory (>0, default 5) and bounded by the discovered model spec
--ratio is passed only when the discovered model contract accepts it
t2v drafts carry no image or frame references (reference tasks route to dreamina-canvas-cli-ref2video)
Model / duration values come only from the live discovery payload; legacy v1.4.18 tokens are never reused
Paid execution is handed off to dreamina-canvas-cli; this Skill never calls --run
Exit 20 / 21 continue via operation wait with the same submitId; a new submitId is never minted
The sunset notice points users away from the legacy dreamina text2video binary
